With one single entry there is no "less" available: I hold them at 0% or at 100%, and zero is exactly what that rule forbids. I am paying that price because both start deep in the band that pays here, both project near the top of the board, and the worry about Stenhouse was his crash rate, not his ceiling — and ceiling is what a top-heavy contest buys.
